scope: A parentless Parent declares a public typed int property with a sole backed block &get. Its immediate Child plainly redeclares the same public int property with its own default and no hook, interface, trait or constructor effect. Direct CV/literal reads, reference fetches, own writes and a defined-RHS destination bind use a Child receiver.

authority: Zend/zend_inheritance.c::do_inherit_property and inherit_property_hook retain Parent's getter while installing the plain Child's physical descriptor.
Zend/zend_object_handlers.c::zend_std_read_property invokes that getter on Child's receiver and returns its by-reference result.
Zend/zend_execute.c::zend_assign_to_property_reference fetches Get before rejecting destination rebinding.
spec/semantics/138-property-references.watsup attaches the selected Child property type source to its backing alias.
